name: okx_mcp
signal_gap: Direct high-frequency perps data from OKX (second-largest derivatives venue). Live funding rates, order books, and futures basis. Complements CoinGlass aggregates with real-time source data. CCXT adapter OKX entry is fallback-only once this adapter is live.
notes: Scoped to DerivativesAgent exclusively. TTL 5s for tickers/funding, 10s for order books. Upgrade to Tier 1 candidate after 200 paper trades. Dependency: CCXT readonly adapter must be updated to mark OKX as fallback after this adapter registers healthy.
